title: ticfac authors the contracts that describe its own formats
description: ticks bundle 7.0.0 keeps only tk-json-manifest and tracker-layout. The rest (job-protocol, ticfac-run-state, lifecycle-invariants, collect-vocabulary, run-event-feed, runners-config-contract, worker-boot-contract, message-context, sweep-selection-contract, sweep-policy-cases, signal-source-cases, sandbox-image-cases, credential-ownership) become ticfac-authored at their 6.3.0 bytes with a ticfac-side version and changelog; contracts.pin.json pins only ticks' two files at 7.0.0. Update CONTRACTS.md and cloudflare/CONTRACTS.md ownership statements.
notes:
